_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard. A Flash project is one movie, plus whatever that movie loads at runtime: a game commonly pulls in more .swf files, images, sounds or data alongside itself. Those must keep the names the movie asks for, because a movie loads them by name relative to itself.

slots.title: Files the movie loads
slots.help: Anything the movie loads while it runs (loadMovie, loadSound, loadVariables, URLLoader): further .swf files, images, sounds, data. Keep the names the movie asks for - it looks them up beside itself. A movie that loads nothing needs none of this.
